name: e-voucher.bg
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But links must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every link text that says where it goes. An icon alone needs an aria-label.
summary: www.e-voucher.bg scores 76 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 27 are at risk, and 29 pass. Fix first: 30 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 30 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /en, /forgotten-password, /register and 2 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 13 elements on /, /en, /contacts, for example .header-phone and .cta-phone > a[href$="tel:"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 7 elements on /, /en, /contacts, for example #CybotCookiebotDialogBodyEdgeMoreDetailsLink and #CybotCookiebotDialogBodyLevelButtonLevelOptinAllowAll. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 2 titles are shared by more than one page
fix.evidence: "bcard e-vouchers | BORICA" on /, /en, /contacts and 11 more. "Bcard Vouchers Portal | BORICA" on /pages/politika-za-poveritelnost, /en/pages/politika-za-poveritelnost, /text-pages/view/politika-za-poveritelnost.
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

fix.title: 15 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /contacts, /forgotten-password, /register, /pages/obshti-uslovia and 11 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The largest element paints in 1.0 s
